labels.label: bbs:L1_ray_space (REVIEW.md §B L1, gap 1: S(V) as a type with its L-action)

hypotheses.note: represented by the unit sphere of the norm (BBS-Q3); susp(S(V)) homeomorphic to V by (sigma, r) -> r sigma (GX.sphereSusp); the homeomorphism with the quotient model is classical, not formalized
a real normed space; finite-dimensional where G must act continuously

findings: Status partial (round 1): S(V) rests on a READING (the unit sphere for (V minus 0)/R+*); the homeomorphism between the two models is classical and not formalized.
questions: BBS-Q3: the sphere was chosen because susp(S(V)) = V is then explicit and its radius is the norm (the susp topology matches metric balls); is that acceptable as the representation of HS^n downstream?

labels.label: bbs:L1_conic_at_0 (the conic structure of V at 0, REVIEW.md §B L1)

hypotheses.paper: L = linear part of the stabiliser (any linear group)
hypotheses.note: H = the linear isometries of the norm (GX.linIsom); forced for a RADIUS-PRESERVING conic structure (GX.not_conicStructure_of_contraction), NOT claimed necessary for the commented-out draft's construction, which the weaker radial-lift variant (BBS-Celestial) also serves

findings: What is proved is narrower than 'the draft's suspension cannot reach BBS': no RADIUS-PRESERVING conic structure (GX.ConicStructure, BBS-Conic's corrected notion) exists at 0, for any chart and any link, when H contains an element acting on a line as multiplication by c in ]0,1[: GX.not_conicStructure_of_contraction (G = Aff(V)) and GX.not_conicStructure_of_ray_contraction (any G acting on V; G plays no role). Instances: GX.not_conicStructure_nullBoost (SO_0(1,1) on R^2, the round-0 witness), GX.isEmpty_conicStructure_affine_stabilizer (H = G_p in Aff(V), containing v -> v/2) and, for BBS's own group, GX.isEmpty_conicStructure_nullIsom0_stabilizer: G = GX.NullIsom0 = Isom_0(E^{1,2}) in null coordinates (GX.Singular.Quotient, reused), H = G_p = SO_0(1,2), which contains the boost GX.nullIsom0Boost = (a,b,x) -> (2a, b/2, x) (GX.boost (log 2), GX.boost_lin_mem).

Not proved: anything about the commented-out draft's ray-only notion, or the weaker radial-lift variant (for each h in H some g_h in G with phi o g_h = susp(h.) o phi). For G contained in Isom (e.g. Isom_0(E^{1,2})) and the sphere chart, a radial lift g_h fixes 0, hence is linear, and has the ray map of h, hence is a positive multiple of h, hence h (determinant 1): the obstruction then extends to that variant too. This argument is prose, not formalized. So, as far as proved, L1 for BBS cannot use a radius-preserving conic structure; a scale-equivariant suspension (e.g. cone charts (x,t) -> t * s(e x) twisted by the cocycle |k s(e x)|, or a chosen positive radius function on Sigma compatible with the charts) is the natural candidate.

DESIGN NOTE (draft, not a paper claim; source: draft material commented out in these.tex (l.3560–3677), not part of the thesis), for BBS-Conic: GX.lem_analytique_counterexample shows that the draft's lemma (row key draft:lem_analytique, these.tex:3606), read literally, fails: (Aff(V), V) is analytic, the sphere chart satisfies the draft's ray condition for G_p = GL(V) (GX.affineConic_isRayCompatible), but 2.id acts trivially on S(V) under the induced action, which is therefore not faithful; the counterexample motivates radius preservation in GX.ConicStructure.
questions: Which scale-equivariant suspension should L1 use for BBS (Lorentzian links): the R+*-bundle cone of Sigma (canonical, but not Susp Sigma on the nose), or Susp Sigma with a chosen radius function (non-canonical)?

labels.label: bbs:L1_linear_chart_changes (REVIEW.md §B L1, gap 2: the cone of an (L,S(V))-chart is an (Aff,V)-chart with linear chart changes)
findings: The cone charts of (H,S(V))-charts e, e' of Sigma differ near every point by a linear isometry of V (h.linear, h in H), and the cone over the model sphere is regular at the apex for dim V >= 2.
Status partial (round 1): the hypothesis is strengthened (H = linIsom V, the linear isometries, not an arbitrary linear group).

labels.label: bbs:L1_bridge_quotientBase (REVIEW.md §B L1, gap 3)
questions: The bridge 'celestial suspension = quotientBase models' is not attempted; for the Lorentzian line models it is blocked by the obstruction above (no radius-preserving conic structure when H contains a boost).

kb_proposals: An affine equivalence fixing 0 is its linear part (GX.affine_apply_eq_linear, from AffineMap.linearMap_vsub); use it to move scalars through elements of a stabiliser of 0 in V ≃ᵃ[ℝ] V under GX's scoped affineEquivMulAction.

LocallyConnectedSpace of a link L follows from that of susp(L) (GX.Susp.locallyConnectedSpace_of: project a connected neighbourhood of (sigma,1) by Susp.dir); for the unit sphere of a normed space use GX.locallyConnectedSpace_raySphere (an instance) rather than searching mathlib, which has none at this pin.

GX already has BBS's group: GX.NullIsom0 (Isom_0(E^{1,2}) in null coordinates, GX.Singular.Quotient) with GX.boost / GX.boost_lin_mem; instantiate Lorentzian claims there rather than on ad hoc subgroups of Aff(R^2).
